description: Orientation: what frontend development is, how the client-server model works, what happens between a click and a rendered page, and how Forge's Learn/Practice/Grow loop works.

lessons.title: What Is Frontend Development?
lessons.description: Understand what frontend engineers actually build, how frontend differs from design and backend work, and why HTML, CSS, and JavaScript are the starting point.
lessons.originalIntent: Understand what frontend engineers actually build, how frontend differs from design and backend work, and why HTML, CSS, and JavaScript are the starting point.

lessons.title: How the Web Works
lessons.description: Build the core mental model of the web: a browser sends a request to a server, the server sends back a response, and the browser uses that response to continue building the experience.
lessons.originalIntent: Build the core mental model of the web: a browser sends a request to a server, the server sends back a response, and the browser uses that response to continue building the experience.

lessons.title: What Happens When You Click a Link?
lessons.description: Follow a webpage request from a user's click through DNS, the server response, and the browser's first rendering steps.
lessons.topicTitle: What Happens When You Click A Link
lessons.originalIntent: Follow a webpage request from a user's click through DNS, the server response, and the browser's first rendering steps.

lessons.title: Browser, Server, and Client
lessons.description: Understand the different jobs of the browser and server, why the browser is called the client, and which responsibilities belong on each side of a web application.
lessons.originalIntent: Understand the different jobs of the browser and server, why the browser is called the client, and which responsibilities belong on each side of a web application.

lessons.title: How Forge Works
lessons.description: Learn how Forge's Learn, Practice, and Grow loop turns lessons into active skill-building, and understand what to do after you finish a lesson.
